title: Dual Song Spotlight
description: This week has two spotlights: America’s “Sister Golden Hair” brings warm classic-rock lift and easy singalong glow, while Fleetwood Mac’s “Songbird” gives Djembe a tender Christine McVie ballad moment for quiet devotion and room-hushing emotion.
songListNote: Dual Song of the Week: “Sister Golden Hair” by America and “Songbird” by Fleetwood Mac are both joining the request catalog this week.
